title: The PROBATE AND ADMINISTRATION ACT, 1977 (1920 A.D.)
full_text: The PROBATE AND ADMINISTRATION ACT, 1977 (1920 A.D.) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197729 Act Number: 29 Enactment Date: 1920-09-11 Act Year: 1977 Short Title: The PROBATE AND ADMINISTRATION ACT, 1977 (1920 A.D.) Long Title: An Act to provide for the grant of Probates of Wills and Letters of Administration to the estates of certain deceased persons.
